BrochureContent.Content:
A superior 4/5 bedroomed two storied residence standing on C.0.7163 acre elevated site with commanding views of the surrounding countryside.
 The property comes to market in pristine condition and should appeal to those in search of an excellent family home
 This property is superbly located convenient to all amenities and within easy access to all major road networks.

Ground floor: Rec hall 3.8m x 2.8m with tiled floor
 Sitting room 5.1m x 3.8m with fireplace
 Sun room 4.9m x 3.5m with patio doors to side
 Kitchen/dining room 7.6m x 3.5m tiled floor fully fitted including island and American fridge Utility 3.4m x 2.8m fully fitted and equipped tiled floor
 Wheelchair accessible WC & WHB
 Bedroom/study 3.3m x 2.9m
 First floor is approached via a very attractive pine staircase with half landing
 Master bedroom 5.2m x 3.6m with built in wardrobes ensuite 2.5m x 2.1m with pump shower
 Bedroom (2) 3.8m x 3.1m plus en-suite 2.9m x 1.0m built in wardrobe
 Bedroom (3) 3.5m x 3.2m built in wardrobe
 Bedroom (4) 3.4m x 3.0m built in wardrobe
 Family bathroom 3.1m x 1.9m
 Walk in hot press on landing

O.F.C.H. throughout
 U.P.V.C. windows
 Double locking hardwood front door 
Excellent lawn area
Schools, Shops all within easy access
Septic tank sewerage system on site
Boundaries clearly defined
